verified malware: Member of the alelo-* sentinel-version (99.0.x) dep-confusion campaign, same publisher contawpp2026id <0xy12@proton.me> and same simultaneous publish burst. preinstall/postinstall auto-exec exfil of process.env to attacker infrastructure; exemplar alelo-core read byte-for-byte.

verified malware: Third rotated name of the same campaign, published after notafollower1 was retracted. Postinstall node -e fetching process.env.ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4 with the task path and an r.json() handler, so the ECS task definition including the task IAM role ARN and container image URIs is printed into the CI build log. This name was itself unpublished at 2026-08-13T23:14:09Z, continuing a publish, probe and retract cycle of roughly 45 to 90 minutes with a numeric suffix added each round. Convicted on the monitor-recorded hook body; the recorded string is truncated at 98 characters so any further sink was not observed and is not asserted. No IOCs are emitted because the environment variable and the metadata address are standard AWS infrastructure present in every ECS task.
